hashEncoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=False for object hashes; raw file bytes for file hashes.
approvalScope: Carry forward all 256 exact existing fine-topic guide texts and all 32 broad-area names under explicit source-revision provenance. Twenty-eight guides were substantively reviewed (27 source/destination topics plus one additional representative-selection change); the other 228 have byte-equivalent parsed curation evidence before and after revision. Preserve original guide authorship and record this approval separately. This does not claim exhaustive abstract review or perfect semantic clustering.
reviewMethod: Read all affected guide texts, corrected original abstracts, surviving representative evidence, and every added representative; compared old/new memberships and representative selections. Original replacement title/abstract pages had separately been visually verified.

topics.title: Learned Representations for Long-Horizon Planning
topics.rationale: Removing a tree-ensemble paper with an unrelated planning abstract leaves the latent-state and long-horizon planning evidence intact.

topics.title: Kernel Learning and Statistical Function Estimation
topics.rationale: The corrected invariant kernel-feature paper fits function-space geometry; the guide remains supported by effective-dimension, kernel regression and Krein-space representatives.

topics.title: Neural Learning Dynamics and Constructive Architectures
topics.rationale: The revised membership concerns early neural architectures and learning. The added probabilistic neural-computation representative supports the existing account of representations and learning dynamics.

topics.title: Sample-Efficient Policy Learning and Control
topics.rationale: The network-routing reinforcement-learning paper fits policy learning. Removing the misattributed ovarian-tumor abstract does not change the sample-efficient control account.

topics.title: Boosting, Weak Learning, and Classification Guarantees
topics.rationale: The corrected boosting decision-tree paper directly supports the ensemble and weak-learning domain.

topics.title: Gaussian-Process Regression and Learned Function Priors
topics.rationale: The corrected Gaussian-process feature-selection paper remains in this topic and is consistent with the GP modeling guide.

topics.title: Flexible Dependence Modeling and Conditional Independence
topics.rationale: Removing the reading model leaves the copula, dependence and conditional-independence evidence unchanged.

topics.title: Exploration Complexity and Regret in Reinforcement Learning
topics.rationale: The new risk-sensitive Q-learning representative broadens the control criteria but does not contradict the dominant exploration and guarantee-focused guide. The removed policy-search representative remains a corpus member.

topics.title: Code Models, Program Semantics, and Correctness Evaluation
topics.rationale: Correctly assigned instruction scheduling supports the existing compiler history. New ReGAL evidence supports program semantics and execution-preserving abstraction; repository-context work remains in the topic.

topics.title: Analog Neural Hardware and Physical Learning Dynamics
topics.rationale: Removing one synapse-hardware member leaves the analog neural hardware guide supported by the unchanged physical-computing representatives.

topics.title: Language-Model Mechanisms and Systematic Generalization
topics.rationale: The corrected reading-aloud model adds early connectionist language-mechanism evidence. The existing guide already separates early language learning from modern transformer mechanisms.

topics.title: Latent Dynamical Systems and Continuous-Time Prediction
topics.rationale: Chaotic time-series modeling by recurrent networks directly supports the dynamics and continuous-time prediction domain.

topics.title: Scene Geometry from Sparse and Multimodal Observations
topics.rationale: Removing the biological disparity paper leaves the scene-reconstruction and sparse-view geometry representatives intact.

topics.title: Neural Expressivity, Learnability, and Compute Bounds
topics.rationale: Removing a restricted-training-set learning analysis leaves the expressivity and neural computation-bound representatives intact.

topics.title: Neuromorphic Vision and Sensorimotor Hardware
topics.rationale: Adding the original orientation-processing chip and removing the scheduling paper improves alignment with the sensorimotor hardware guide. Surviving analog eye-movement and motion-sensing evidence supports the text.

topics.title: Visual Attention and Efficient Perceptual Representation
topics.rationale: Removing decision-tree and stimulus-encoding papers leaves visual-attention evidence intact. The new variational visual-attention representative supports the same scanpath and saliency concepts.

topics.title: Metric Learning and Geometric Similarity
topics.rationale: Corrected graph matching remains consistent with geometric similarity and metric learning; current representative evidence is unchanged.

topics.title: Development and Mechanistic Modeling of Visual Circuits
topics.rationale: Corrected Hebbian visual-development, eye-tracking and binocular-disparity papers fit the biological visual-circuit domain; removing chaotic forecasting improves coherence.

topics.title: Learnability and Distribution-Dependent Sample Complexity
topics.rationale: The exact restricted-training-set benchmark is compatible with learning theory. The distribution-dependent sample-complexity guide remains supported by unchanged representatives.

topics.title: Explicit and Implicit Regularization in Neural Learning
topics.rationale: The wrongly attributed orientation-chip representative has been removed. Its replacement directly studies early stopping and overfitting; the existing guide never depended on a chip-specific claim.

topics.title: Decision-Tree Optimization, Interpretation, and Verification
topics.rationale: Corrected decision-tree risk minimization and perturb-and-combine tree ensembles support this domain. Moving boosting to its own topic does not invalidate the tree optimization guide.

topics.title: Clinical Prediction with Heterogeneous Health Records
topics.rationale: Removing the product-unit architecture paper leaves clinical prediction and heterogeneous health-record evidence intact.

topics.title: Reinforcement Learning across Time Scales and Task Structure
topics.rationale: Moving call-routing reinforcement learning to a related policy-learning topic does not alter the temporal-structure guide supported by unchanged representatives.

topics.title: Source Separation and Noise-Aware Signal Representation
topics.rationale: Removing the kernel-feature paper leaves source separation and noise-aware signal evidence intact.

topics.title: Topological Representations and Persistent Structure
topics.rationale: The added adaptive-knot paper explicitly uses topological mapping and self-organizing maps. The guide already acknowledges early neighborhood-preservation work while retaining its dominant persistent-topology focus.

topics.title: Attractor Networks, Oscillations, and Neural Dynamics
topics.rationale: Removing adaptive-knot regression leaves the attractor, oscillation and recurrent-dynamics evidence intact.

topics.title: Synaptic Computation and Spike-Based Learning
topics.rationale: The corrected synapse-device and neural-population encoding papers are adjacent to the stated synaptic-computation domain. Existing stochastic-synapse and spike-learning representatives continue to support the guide; the guide makes no invented hardware-specific claims.

topics.title: Symmetry, Equivariance, and Canonical Representations
topics.rationale: Additional representative-selection change outside the source/destination union was detected by a full old/new evidence comparison and explicitly reviewed. Deep Symmetry Networks supports the existing symmetry-group architecture guide. Approximately Equivariant Neural Processes remains a corpus member, so the guide description of approximate symmetry remains supported.

unchangedOtherGuidesReviewStatus: Carry-forward approved by exact before/after curation-evidence equality, not a new prose review.

broadAreaApproval.rationale: Broad-group IDs and child-topic memberships are unchanged. Corrected papers do not change the dominant concepts of their reviewed fine topics; the previously authored 32 broad names remain appropriate.

curationSnapshotRequirement: Archive the previous snapshot, replace current snapshot with revised evidence, and retain this approval and original authorship as provenance.
